name: Reels
author: Voltage
description: For the Jackpot theme: every song gets a rarity (common, rare, epic, legendary) from how often you play it, plus the odd lucky surprise, and the slot reels land to match: a legendary song lands a full line of sevens. Purely a look: no betting, credits or odds.

settings.label: Lucky surprises (now and then a song lands one rarity higher)
